notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section, Pub. L. 88–506, § 2, Aug. 30, 1964, 78 Stat. 639, which authorized distribution to tribal members of prorated shares of funds appropriated for a certain judgment against the United States, was omitted from the Code as being of special and not general application.

ancestors.heading: TILLAMOOK AND NEHALEM BANDS OF THE TILLAMOOK INDIANS: DISTRIBUTION OF JUDGMENT FUND
